registryBasis: The state Dirección de Catastro y Registro Público del Estado de Zacatecas is an evidenced cadastral custodian, and the Presidencia Municipal de Zacatecas publishes a municipal Catastro service page and cadastral map plans. The state site lists Zacatecas as a cadastral delegation and the municipal page documents cadastral mapping, plan certification, boundary survey, and cadastral-key services.

officialSources.publisher: Gobierno del Estado de Zacatecas, Dirección de Catastro y Registro Público
officialSources.observation: Official state cadastral site lists the Zacatecas delegation and state cadastral contact.
Official service list includes cadastral cartography, plan certification, cadastral boundary surveys, plans, and physical verification.
Municipal Catastro page documents municipal cadastral procedures and requirements.
Official cadastral management application is reachable as a login-protected interface; no login was attempted.
Official 2021 municipal Catastro map sheet with parcel/block labels and Catastro Municipal title block; static map evidence only, not machine-readable parcel geometry.

serviceMetadata.note: The public page exposed a login wall and no anonymous service configuration or parcel response was obtained. Static official PDFs show cadastral mapping but do not establish a parcel API schema.

runtimeAssessment.reason: A local/state cadastral custodian and official cadastral products are evidenced, but no anonymous parcel API, safe native parcel identity, geometry response, CRS, or adapter-level qualification was obtained.

pointBasis: Immutable WUP queue point retained exactly in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate adjustment was made to seek a parcel hit.
